instructions_to_main_agent: Retain existing Leonida Explorer theme (Russo One + Outfit font, dark synthwave oklch tokens in styles.css).
Build the dedicated Arcade section with all 10 game tiles, marking 'Leonida Fishing' and 'Neon Highway' as fully playable with interactive 60fps HTML5 Canvas engines.
Implement rock-solid touch controls for iPhone: touch-action: none on game canvas, prevent body scrolling, support touch drag / left-right buttons.
Ensure server-side validation/recording of completed game sessions (session verification, anti-cheat score validation, XP & Coin payout).
Implement 150-Leonida-Coins unlock for locked secret spots on the map/spots list, keeping the first 10 spots free as requested.
Separate Highscores (game performance) from XP (profile progress) and Coins (currency).
Provide clear Start, Instruction, Pause, Game Over, and Top-5 Leaderboard screens for each minigame with high-contrast neon styling and test attributes (data-testid).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic flat gray layouts or generic center alignments; embrace high-energy Synthwave neon cards with glowing borders and deep purple glass panels.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.performance: Games must use requestAnimationFrame with delta-time physics and canvas double-buffering. Never trigger React state updates inside the 60fps render loop (keep game state in refs).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.iphone_safeguards: Handle iOS safe area insets via env(safe-area-inset-top) and env(safe-area-inset-bottom). Use touch-action: none on game screens to eliminate rubber-banding and pull-to-refresh.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_attributes: All buttons, game tiles, modals, coin counters, and rank items must include data-testid (e.g. data-testid='arcade-nav-button', data-testid='game-tile-neon-highway', data-testid='coin-balance-display').
